inputs.name: searchLoops.input
inputs.description: Optional project root and case-insensitive query; defaults to the current directory and all matching templates and loop instances.

inputs.name: renderLoopSearchResults.results
inputs.description: Search rows to display in their supplied order.

outputs.name: searchLoops
outputs.description: Templates and loop rows filtered by query; malformed or unreadable persisted loops become diagnostic rows and missing states are omitted.

outputs.name: renderLoopSearchResults
outputs.description: Plain-text kind, identifier, title and summary for each row, or a no-match message.

errors.name: Loop search filesystem failure
errors.description: Unexpected directory or template discovery failures propagate; individual persisted loop failures are represented by diagnostic rows.
